snippet.title: Barbie: Super Sports (PC) - Commercial
snippet.description:
Commercial from the late 1990s, or 2000. Recovered from VHS.

This time, I had to "fix" with MPEG Streamclip first, then crop with Mpg2Cut2. Hopefully the quality is satisfactory.
